description: Set up PikPak WebDAV and mount it in Infuse, VidHub or rclone, including the membership requirement and quota ceiling. WebDAV 挂载指南，说明会员门槛与 25% 配额上限。 Triggers: PikPak WebDAV, mount PikPak in Infuse, VidHub, rclone, connect media player, WebDAV speed limit, connected-app quota. WebDAV requires an active membership. 日本語: PikPak を WebDAV で Infuse / VidHub / rclone に接続したいとき。WebDAV は有効な会員権限が必要です。한국어: PikPak을 WebDAV로 Infuse / VidHub / rclone에 연결할 때. WebDAV는 유료 멤버십이 필요합니다.
